Data Science has become an essential tool to extract value from data for any organization that collects, stores and processes data as part of its operations. title: Introduction to Apache Flink
description: There’s growing interest in learning how to analyze streaming data in large-scale systems such as web traffic, financial transactions, machine logs, industrial sensors, and many others. But analyzing data streams at scale has been difficult to do well—until now. This practical book delivers a deep introduction to Apache Flink, a highly innovative open source stream processor with a surprising range of capabilities.

title: Machine Learning and Generative AI for Marketing
description:

With practical examples and hands-on projects, this book empowers you to analyze and predict customer behaviors, personalize campaigns, and elevate your marketing efforts.

What this Book will help me do

Master advanced AI and machine learning techniques for marketing.
Implement predictive models to enhance customer engagement and decision-making.
Perceive customer behaviors using advanced segmentation and analytics.
Craft personalized marketing strategies through generative AI.
Learn ethical and compliant practices for leveraging AI in marketing.

Yoon Hyup Hwang and Nicholas C. Burtch have combined their expertise as seasoned professionals in the fields of machine learning and marketing analytics to bring you this comprehensive resource. Both authors have extensive experience working with marketing data and applying advanced AI techniques to real-world challenges. Their collaborative approach to writing ensures that readers are guided through both the technical and practical aspects of applying AI in marketing.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for data analysts and scientists wanting to apply ML to marketing contexts, ML engineers looking to leverage generative AI for content marketing, and business professionals interested in integrating AI into marketing strategies. Readers should have intermediate Python proficiency and a fundamental understanding of ML concepts.

title: The Fatal Flaw of AI Implementation
description: Many managers are excited about smart machines but are struggling to apply machines' limited intelligence. Indeed, computers can process data just fine, but to generate competitive advantage from machine learning applications, organizations must upgrade their employees' skills. Companies will also need to redesign employee accountabilities to empower and motivate them to deploy smart machines when doing so will enhance outcomes.

De hecho, los ordenadores pueden procesar datos simplemente bien, pero para generar ventaja competitiva de las aplicaciones de aprendizaje automático, las organizaciones deben mejorar las habilidades de sus empleados. Las empresas también tendrán que rediseñar las responsabilidades de los empleados para empoderarlos y motivarlos a desplegar máquinas inteligentes al hacerlo mejorarán los resultados.

title: Show AI--Don't Tell It

Stakeholders don't invest in AI because they understand the tech—they invest when its business impact is clear and undeniable. In Show AI—Don't Tell It, AI executive and business strategist Dr. Lisa Palmer reveals how to use visual storytelling to make AI's value tangible, turning complex ideas into clear business outcomes that drive buy-in, adoption, and scale. Instead of vague theories and hype, this book provides clear frameworks, practical tools, and proven visualization techniques to help leaders secure funding, accelerate implementation, and maximize AI's impact.

Applying her Bold AI Leadership Model, Dr. Palmer lays out a structured approach to AI success:

Mindset: The four Applied AI Guiding Principles—Business Value, Speed with Rigor, Simplicity, and Human-Centricity—keep AI initiatives focused, efficient, and impactful.
Strategic Priorities: The five AI Success Pillars—Value Creation, Customer-Centricity, Collaborative Teams, Cultural Shifts, and Data as a Strategic Asset—ensure AI drives measurable business results.
Practical Tools: The Visualization Tool Decision Framework, featuring over 20 strategic visualization tools, helps leaders simplify complexity, overcome resistance, and communicate AI's impact with clarity and confidence.

A must-read for executives, business leaders, and AI practitioners, Show AI—Don't Tell It provides the mindset, strategy, and tools needed to translate AI's potential into tangible value. Whether you're seeking stakeholder buy-in, funding approval, or faster adoption, this book shows you exactly how to use visual storytelling to accelerate business success with AI.

title: An Introduction to Self-Report Measurement
Take Control of Your Online Privacy, 5th Edition
description:
Learn what's private online (not much)—and what to do about it! Version 5.1, updated January 30, 2025

Nearly everything you do say or do online can be recorded and scrutinized by advertisers, data brokers, and a long list of other people and organizations---often without your knowledge or consent. When your personal data falls into the wrong hands, you risk theft, embarrassment, and worse. But you can take steps to greatly improve your online privacy without sacrificing all your convenience.

Nowadays, online privacy is extremely hard to come by. Corporations, governments, and scammers alike go out of their way to gather up massive amounts of your personal data. The situation feels bleak, but you have more control than you may realize. In this book, Joe Kissell helps you to develop a sensible, customized online privacy strategy. No matter what devices or operating systems you use, you’ll find practical advice that ordinary people need to handle common privacy needs.

The massively revised fifth edition of Take Control of Your Online Privacy is packed with information that helps you get a handle on current topics in online privacy, including data breaches, hardware bugs, quantum computing, two-factor authentication, how ads can track you, and much more.

You’ll receive savvy advice about topics such as these:

Why worry? Find out who wants your private data, why they want it, and what that means to you.

Determine your personal risk level, learn which privacy factors are most important to you, what you can and can't control, and what extra steps you can take if you're at a high risk of being personally targeted.

Hear some good news (five steps you could take that would massively increase your online privacy)…and some bad news (why some of those steps may be difficult or infeasible).

Remove personal information from Google and data brokers, though the process comes with limitations and gotchas.

Discover Apple-Specific Privacy Features for users of Macs, iPhones, and iPads.

Manage your internet connection: Secure your Wi-Fi network and keep your data from leaking out. Find advice on why and when to use a VPN or a network-connected privacy appliance, plus why you should be skeptical of VPN reviews.

Browse and search the web: Avoid bogus websites, control your cookies and history, block ads, browse and search anonymously, and find out who is tracking you.

Send and receive email: Find out how your email could be intercepted, learn techniques for encrypting email when necessary, get tips for sending email anonymously, and know when email is not the best way to communicate.

Watch your social media: Understand the risks of sharing personal information online (especially on Facebook!), tweak your settings, and consider common-sense precautions.

Talk and chat online: Consider to what extent any phone call, text message, or online chat is private, and find tips for enhancing privacy when using these channels.

Protect your smart devices: Address privacy issues with "Internet of Things" devices like smart TVs, smart speakers, and home automation gear.

Think mobile: Ponder topics like supercookies, location reporting, photo storage, spear phishing, and more as you decide how to handle privacy for a mobile phone or tablet.

Help your children: As a parent, you may want to take extra steps to protect your children's privacy. Find a few key tips to keep in mind.
translatedDescription:
¡Aprenda qué es privado en línea (no mucho) y qué hacer al respecto! Versión 5.1, actualizada 30 de enero de 2025

Casi todo lo que dice o hace en línea puede ser grabado y escrutado por anunciantes, corredores de datos, y una larga lista de otras personas y organizaciones, a menudo sin su conocimiento o consentimiento. Cuando sus datos personales caen en las manos equivocadas, corres el riesgo de robo, vergüenza y peor. Pero puede tomar medidas para mejorar su privacidad en línea sin sacrificar toda su comodidad.

Hoy en día, la privacidad en línea es extremadamente difícil de conseguir. Las corporaciones, los gobiernos y los estafadores salen de su camino para reunir cantidades masivas de sus datos personales. La situación se siente sombría, pero usted tiene más control de lo que puede darse cuenta. En este libro, Joe Kissell le ayuda a desarrollar una estrategia de privacidad en línea sensible y personalizada. No importa qué dispositivos o sistemas operativos utiliza, encontrará consejos prácticos que las personas comunes necesitan para manejar necesidades comunes de privacidad.

La quinta edición masivamente revisada de Take Control of Your Online Privacy está llena de información que le ayuda a conseguir un mango sobre temas actuales en privacidad en línea, incluyendo brechas de datos, errores de hardware, cálculo cuántico, autenticación de dos factores, cómo los anuncios pueden rastrear, y mucho más.

Recibirás consejos sobre temas como estos:

¿Por qué preocuparse? Averigüe quién quiere sus datos privados, por qué lo quieren y qué significa para usted.

Determine su nivel de riesgo personal, aprenda qué factores de privacidad son más importantes para usted, qué puede y no puede controlar, y qué pasos adicionales puede tomar si usted está en un alto riesgo de ser dirigido personalmente.

Oír algunas buenas noticias (cinco pasos que podría tomar que aumentaría enormemente su privacidad en línea) ... y algunas malas noticias (por qué algunos de esos pasos pueden ser difíciles o infeables).

Eliminar la información personal de Google y los corredores de datos, aunque el proceso viene con limitaciones y gotchas.

Descubre las funciones de privacidad de Apple-Specific para usuarios de Macs, iPhones y iPads.

Administra tu conexión a Internet: Asegura tu red Wi-Fi y evita que tus datos se escapen. Encuentre consejo sobre por qué y cuándo utilizar un VPN o un dispositivo de privacidad conectado a la red, además de por qué debe ser escéptico de las reseñas de VPN.

Examine y busque la web: Evite sitios web falsos, controle sus cookies e historia, bloquee anuncios, busque y busque de forma anónima, y descubra quién le está rastreando.

Enviar y recibir correo electrónico: Descubra cómo su correo electrónico podría ser interceptado, aprenda técnicas para encriptar correo electrónico cuando sea necesario, obtenga consejos para enviar correo electrónico de forma anónima, y sepa cuándo el correo electrónico no es la mejor manera de comunicarse.

Vea sus redes sociales: Entender los riesgos de compartir información personal en línea (especialmente en Facebook!), ajustar sus configuraciones y considerar precauciones de sentido común.

Hable y chat en línea: Considere hasta qué punto cualquier llamada telefónica, mensaje de texto o chat en línea es privado, y encuentre consejos para mejorar la privacidad al utilizar estos canales.

Protege tus dispositivos inteligentes: Aborda los problemas de privacidad con dispositivos "Internet of Things" como televisores inteligentes, altavoces inteligentes y equipo de automatización doméstica.

Piense en el móvil: temas como supercookies, reportaje de ubicación, almacenamiento de fotos, phishing de lanza, y más como usted decide cómo manejar la privacidad para un teléfono móvil o tableta.

Ayuda a tus hijos: Como padre, es posible que desee tomar medidas adicionales para proteger la privacidad de sus hijos. Encuentra algunos consejos clave para tener en cuenta.

title: Graph Machine Learning
description:
Graph Machine Learning introduces you to processing and analyzing graph data using machine learning techniques. You'll explore how to harness the relationships within graph structures for applications ranging from social networks to financial systems, enabling predictive modeling and analytics tasks.

What this Book will help me do

Understand and apply graph machine learning techniques for a variety of data models.
Learn to implement supervised and unsupervised algorithms for graph embeddings.
Apply graph analytics to real-life scenarios like social networks and financial transactions.
Build and scale applications that utilize graph-based data representations.
Master essential graph theory concepts and their use in machine learning pipelines.

Author(s)

Claudio Stamile, a researcher and data scientist, Aldo Marzullo, an expert in graph algorithms, and Enrico Deusebio, a consultant in machine learning applications, combine their expertise to bring this comprehensive guide to readers. Their practical approach ensures the content is immediately applicable to real-world challenges.

Who is it for?

This book is tailored for data scientists, analysts, and software developers looking to understand and leverage graph structures in machine learning. Readers should ideally have a foundational knowledge of Python programming, basic graph concepts, and machine learning principles. It's perfect for professionals seeking to expand their analytics capabilities into graph-based data processing.

title: An Introduction to Machine Learning Interpretability, 2nd Edition
description:
Innovation and competition are driving analysts and data scientists toward increasingly complex predictive modeling and machine learning algorithms. This complexity makes these models accurate, but can also make their predictions difficult to understand. When accuracy outpaces interpretability, human trust suffers, affecting business adoption, model validation efforts, and regulatory oversight.

In the updated edition of this ebook, Patrick Hall and Navdeep Gill from H2O.ai introduce the idea of machine learning interpretability and examine a set of machine learning techniques, algorithms, and models to help data scientists improve the accuracy of their predictive models while maintaining a high degree of interpretability. While some industries require model transparency, such as banking, insurance, and healthcare, machine learning practitioners in almost any vertical will likely benefit from incorporating the discussed interpretable models, and debugging, explanation, and fairness approaches into their workflow.

This second edition discusses new, exact model explanation techniques, and de-emphasizes the trade-off between accuracy and interpretability. This edition also includes up-to-date information on cutting-edge interpretability techniques and new figures to illustrate the concepts of trust and understanding in machine learning models.

Learn how machine learning and predictive modeling are applied in practice
Understand social and commercial motivations for machine learning interpretability, fairness, accountability, and transparency
Get a definition of interpretability and learn about the groups leading interpretability research
Examine a taxonomy for classifying and describing interpretable machine learning approaches
Gain familiarity with new and more traditional interpretable modeling approaches
See numerous techniques for understanding and explaining models and predictions
Read about methods to debug prediction errors, sociological bias, and security vulnerabilities in predictive models
Get a feel for the techniques in action with code examples

Cuando la precisión supera la interpretabilidad, la confianza humana sufre, afectando la adopción empresarial, los esfuerzos de validación modelo y la supervisión regulatoria.

En la edición actualizada de este ebook, Patrick Hall y Navdeep Gill de H2O.ai introducen la idea de la interpretación del aprendizaje automático y examinan un conjunto de técnicas de aprendizaje automático, algoritmos y modelos para ayudar a los científicos de datos a mejorar la precisión de sus modelos predictivos manteniendo un alto grado de interpretabilidad. Si bien algunas industrias requieren transparencia modelo, como la banca, el seguro y la salud, los profesionales del aprendizaje automático en casi cualquier vertical se beneficiarán probablemente de incorporar los modelos interpretables discutidos, y depurar, explicar y equidad enfoques en su flujo de trabajo.

En esta segunda edición se analizan nuevas técnicas de explicación modelo exacta y se descalifica el intercambio entre precisión e interpretación. title: Getting Started with Artificial Intelligence
description:
Artificial intelligence techniques are becoming a fundamental component of business growth across a wide range of industries. Enterprise technologies that automate and detect patterns can augment human expertise, empowering both employees and applications to make richer, more data-driven decisions.

Complete with case studies, implementation examples, and a survey of the current landscape, this book serves as an ideal starting point for your journey into enterprise AI.

As a developer tasked with building enterprise-level AI applications, you’re looking to learn about the tools and techniques that will help you get the job done. In this book, authors Tom Markiewicz and Josh Zheng—developer advocates for IBM Watson—explore three of the more common uses for AI in the enterprise: natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and chatbots.You'll also learn methods for creating a data pipeline that forms the backbone for building these applications.

Explore why NLP is the key to mining unstructured data in emails, articles, blog posts, customer support discussions, and other documents
Gain practical tips for building chatbots, and learn how these applications are used in the customer support and e-commerce industries
Examine capabilities that computer vision brings to your applications, including image classification and tagging
Get a high-level guide to data pipelines—the backbone of your AI applications

title: Mobile Security and Privacy
description:
Mobile Security and Privacy: Advances, Challenges and Future Research Directions provides the first truly holistic view of leading edge mobile security research from Dr. Man Ho Au and Dr. Raymond Choo—leading researchers in mobile security. Mobile devices and apps have become part of everyday life in both developed and developing countries. As with most evolving technologies, mobile devices and mobile apps can be used for criminal exploitation. Along with the increased use of mobile devices and apps to access and store sensitive, personally identifiable information (PII) has come an increasing need for the community to have a better understanding of the associated security and privacy risks.

Drawing upon the expertise of world-renowned researchers and experts, this volume comprehensively discusses a range of mobile security and privacy topics from research, applied, and international perspectives, while aligning technical security implementations with the most recent developments in government, legal, and international environments. The book does not focus on vendor-specific solutions, instead providing a complete presentation of forward-looking research in all areas of mobile security.

The book will enable practitioners to learn about upcoming trends, scientists to share new directions in research, and government and industry decision-makers to prepare for major strategic decisions regarding implementation of mobile technology security and privacy. In addition to the state-of-the-art research advances, this book also discusses prospective future research topics and open challenges.

Presents the most current and leading edge research on mobile security and privacy, featuring a panel of top experts in the field
Provides a strategic and international overview of the security issues surrounding mobile technologies
Covers key technical topics and provides readers with a complete understanding of the most current research findings along with future research directions and challenges
Enables practitioners to learn about upcoming trends, scientists to share new directions in research, and government and industry decision-makers to prepare for major strategic decisions regarding the implementation of mobile technology security and privacy initiatives

title: High Performance MySQL, 2nd Edition
description:
High Performance MySQL is the definitive guide to building fast, reliable systems with MySQL. Written by noted experts with years of real-world experience building very large systems, this book covers every aspect of MySQL performance in detail, and focuses on robustness, security, and data integrity.High Performance MySQL teaches you advanced techniques in depth so you can bring out MySQL's full power. Learn how to design schemas, indexes, queries and advanced MySQL features for maximum performance, and get detailed guidance for tuning your MySQL server, operating system, and hardware to their fullest potential. You'll also learn practical, safe, high-performance ways to scale your applications with replication, load balancing, high availability, and failover. This second edition is completely revised and greatly expanded, with deeper coverage in all areas. Major additions include:

Emphasis throughout on both performance and reliability
Thorough coverage of storage engines, including in-depth tuning and optimizations for the InnoDB storage engine
Effects of new features in MySQL 5.0 and 5.1, including stored procedures, partitioned databases, triggers, and views
A detailed discussion on how to build very large, highly scalable systems with MySQL
New options for backups and replication
Optimization of advanced querying features, such as full-text searches
Four new appendices

The book also includes chapters on benchmarking, profiling, backups, security, and tools and techniques to help you measure, monitor, and manage your MySQL installations.

title: State of the Art in Neural Networks and Their Applications
description:
State of the Art in Neural Networks and Their Applications, Volume Two presents the latest advances in artificial neural networks and their applications across a wide range of clinical diagnoses. The book provides over views and case studies of advances in the role of machine learning, artificial intelligence, deep learning, cognitive image processing, and suitable data analytics useful for clinical diagnosis and research applications. The application of neural network, artificial intelligence and machine learning methods in biomedical image analysis have resulted in the development of computer-aided diagnostic (CAD) systems that aim towards the automatic early detection of several severe diseases.

State of the Art in Neural Networks and Their Applications is presented in two volumes. Volume One: Neural Networks in Oncology Imaging covers lung cancer, prostate cancer, and bladder cancer. Volume Two: Neural Networks in Brain Disorders and Other Diseases covers autism spectrum disorder, Alzheimer’s disease, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, hypertension, and other diseases. Written by experienced engineers in the field, these two volumes will help engineers, computer scientists, researchers, and clinicians understand the technology and applications of artificial neural networks.

Provides in-depth technical coverage of computer-aided diagnosis (CAD), including coverage of computer-aided classification, unified deep learning frameworks, 3D MRI, PET/CT, and more
Covers deep learning cancer identification from histopathological images, medical image analysis, detection, segmentation and classification via AI

This book is tailored for intermediate Apache Spark users eager to deepen their knowledge in Spark 2.x's advanced features. Ideal for data engineers and big data professionals seeking to enhance their analytics pipelines with Spark. A basic understanding of Spark and Scala is necessary. If you're aiming to optimize Spark for real-world applications, this book is crafted for you.
translatedDescription:
Mastering Apache Spark 2.x es la guía esencial para aprovechar el poder del procesamiento de datos grandes. Sumérgete en análisis de datos en tiempo real, aprendizaje automático y computación de racimo usando funciones y módulos avanzados de Apache Spark como Spark SQL y MLlib.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Gain proficiency in Spark's batch and real-time data processing with SparkSQL.
Técnicas maestras para el aprendizaje automático y el aprendizaje profundo usando SparkML y SystemML.
Entender los principios del procesamiento gráfico de Spark con GraphX y GraphFrames.
Aprende a desplegar Apache Spark de forma eficiente en plataformas como Kubernetes e IBM Cloud.
Optimize Spark cluster performance mediante la configuración de parámetros con eficacia.

Autor(s)

Romeo Kienzler es un profesional experimentado en grandes datos y tecnologías de aprendizaje automático. Con años de experiencia en sistemas distribuidos basados en la nube, Romeo aporta ideas prácticas para aprovechar Apache Spark. Combina su profunda experiencia técnica con un estilo de escritura claro y atractivo.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro está adaptado para usuarios intermedios de Apache Spark deseosos de profundizar su conocimiento en las características avanzadas de Spark 2.x. Ideal para ingenieros de datos y grandes profesionales de datos que buscan mejorar sus tuberías de análisis con Spark. Es necesaria una comprensión básica de Spark y Scala. Si buscas optimizar Spark para aplicaciones reales, este libro está diseñado para ti.

title: Data Hiding Techniques in Windows OS
description:
"This unique book delves down into the capabilities of hiding and obscuring data object within the Windows Operating System. However, one of the most noticeable and credible features of this publication is, it takes the reader from the very basics and background of data hiding techniques, and run’s on the reading-road to arrive at some of the more complex methodologies employed for concealing data object from the human eye and/or the investigation. As a practitioner in the Digital Age, I can see this book siting on the shelves of Cyber Security Professionals, and those working in the world of Digital Forensics – it is a recommended read, and is in my opinion a very valuable asset to those who are interested in the landscape of unknown unknowns. This is a book which may well help to discover more about that which is not in immediate view of the onlooker, and open up the mind to expand its imagination beyond its accepted limitations of known knowns." - John Walker, CSIRT/SOC/Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist
Featured in Digital Forensics Magazine, February 2017

In the digital world, the need to protect online communications increase as the technology behind it evolves. There are many techniques currently available to encrypt and secure our communication channels. Data hiding techniques can take data confidentiality to a new level as we can hide our secret messages in ordinary, honest-looking data files.

Steganography is the science of hiding data. It has several categorizations, and each type has its own techniques in hiding. Steganography has played a vital role in secret communication during wars since the dawn of history. In recent days, few computer users successfully manage to exploit their Windows® machine to conceal their private data.

Businesses also have deep concerns about misusing data hiding techniques. Many employers are amazed at how easily their valuable information can get out of their company walls. In many legal cases a disgruntled employee would successfully steal company private data despite all security measures implemented using simple digital hiding techniques.

Human right activists who live in countries controlled by oppressive regimes need ways to smuggle their online communications without attracting surveillance monitoring systems, continuously scan in/out internet traffic for interesting keywords and other artifacts. The same applies to journalists and whistleblowers all over the world.

Computer forensic investigators, law enforcements officers, intelligence services and IT security professionals need a guide to tell them where criminals can conceal their data in Windows® OS & multimedia files and how they can discover concealed data quickly and retrieve it in a forensic way.

Data Hiding Techniques in Windows OS is a response to all these concerns. Data hiding topics are usually approached in most books using an academic method, with long math equations about how each hiding technique algorithm works behind the scene, and are usually targeted at people who work in the academic arenas. This book teaches professionals and end users alike how they can hide their data and discover the hidden ones using a variety of ways under the most commonly used operating system on earth, Windows®.
translatedDescription:
"Este libro único se divide en las capacidades de ocultar y ocultar objetos de datos dentro del sistema operativo Windows. Sin embargo, una de las características más notables y creíbles de esta publicación es, toma al lector de los mismos fundamentos y antecedentes de las técnicas de ocultación de datos, y se ejecuta en el camino de lectura para llegar a algunas de las metodologías más complejas empleadas para ocultar el objeto de datos del ojo humano y/o la investigación. Como practicante en la Edad Digital, puedo ver este libro sitiendo sobre los estantes de los Profesionales de Seguridad Cibernética, y aquellos que trabajan en el mundo de la Forense Digital – es una lectura recomendada, y es en mi opinión un activo muy valioso para aquellos que están interesados en el paisaje de desconocidos. Este es un libro que bien puede ayudar a descubrir más sobre aquello que no está en la visión inmediata del onlooker, y abrir la mente para expandir su imaginación más allá de sus limitaciones aceptadas de conocidos conocidos." John Walker, CSIRT/SOC/Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist
Destacado en Digital Forensics Magazine, febrero 2017

En el mundo digital, la necesidad de proteger las comunicaciones en línea aumenta a medida que evoluciona la tecnología detrás de ella. Actualmente hay muchas técnicas disponibles para encriptar y asegurar nuestros canales de comunicación. Las técnicas de ocultación de datos pueden llevar la confidencialidad de los datos a un nuevo nivel, ya que podemos ocultar nuestros mensajes secretos en archivos de datos ordinarios de aspecto honesto.

La esteganografía es la ciencia de ocultar datos. Tiene varias categorizaciones, y cada tipo tiene sus propias técnicas ocultas. La esteganografía ha desempeñado un papel vital en la comunicación secreta durante las guerras desde el amanecer de la historia. En los últimos días, pocos usuarios de computadoras logran explotar su máquina Windows® para ocultar sus datos privados.

Las empresas también tienen profundas preocupaciones sobre el mal uso de técnicas de ocultación de datos. Muchos empleadores se sorprenden de lo fácil que su valiosa información puede salir de sus paredes de la compañía. En muchos casos legales un empleado descontento robaría con éxito los datos privados de la empresa a pesar de todas las medidas de seguridad implementadas utilizando simples técnicas de ocultamiento digital.

Los activistas de derechos humanos que viven en países controlados por regímenes opresivos necesitan formas de contrabandear sus comunicaciones en línea sin atraer sistemas de vigilancia, escaneando continuamente el tráfico de Internet para palabras clave interesantes y otros artefactos. Lo mismo se aplica a periodistas y denunciantes en todo el mundo.

Los investigadores forenses informáticos, los agentes del orden, los servicios de inteligencia y los profesionales de seguridad informática necesitan una guía para decirles dónde los delincuentes pueden ocultar sus datos en Windows® OS & archivos multimedia y cómo pueden descubrir datos ocultos rápidamente y recuperarlos de forma forense.

Data Hiding Techniques en Windows OS es una respuesta a todas estas preocupaciones. Los datos que ocultan temas se abordan generalmente en la mayoría de los libros usando un método académico, con largas ecuaciones de matemáticas sobre cómo cada algoritmo de técnica oculta funciona detrás de la escena, y son generalmente dirigidos a personas que trabajan en los ámbitos académicos. Este libro enseña a profesionales y usuarios finales por igual cómo pueden ocultar sus datos y descubrir los ocultos utilizando una variedad de formas bajo el sistema operativo más utilizado en la tierra, Windows®.

title: Applied Machine Learning and High-Performance Computing on AWS
description:
Dive into the fascinating world of applied machine learning with high-performance computing on AWS. This book combines the fundamentals of HPC with practical techniques to harness the power of cloud-based machine learning. By exploring end-to-end workflows, you will learn best practices to design, train, and deploy scalable ML applications.

What this Book will help me do

Explore foundational concepts of high-performance computing in combination with machine learning applications.
Understand data storage, networking, and compute strategies for HPC workloads.
Learn how to train and deploy massive ML models using distributed computing on AWS.
Master performance tuning and optimization techniques for ML models in production environments.
Develop practical knowledge for applying HPC-driven ML solutions in industries such as genomics and autonomous vehicles.

Author(s)

Mani Khanuja, Farooq Sabir, Shreyas Subramanian, and Trenton Potgieter bring a wealth of expertise in machine learning and cloud computing. Together, they have extensive experience in implementing scalable ML applications in various domains. Their unique insights provide practical guidance for learners aiming to excel in ML with AWS.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for machine learning engineers and data scientists with prior knowledge of ML principles, aiming to expand into high-performance computing. It is also suitable for domain specialists in genomics, autonomous vehicles, or CFD who wish to integrate ML principles using AWS. With its practical examples, it's an asset for professionals aiming to enhance their skillset in scalable cloud solutions.
translatedDescription:
Sumérgete en el fascinante mundo del aprendizaje de máquina aplicada con computación de alto rendimiento en AWS. Este libro combina los fundamentos de HPC con técnicas prácticas para aprovechar el poder del aprendizaje automático basado en la nube. Al explorar los flujos de trabajo de extremo a extremo, aprenderá las mejores prácticas para diseñar, entrenar y desplegar aplicaciones ML escalables.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Explore conceptos fundamentales de computación de alto rendimiento en combinación con aplicaciones de aprendizaje automático.
Comprenda el almacenamiento de datos, la creación de redes y computar estrategias para la carga de trabajo de HPC.
Aprende cómo entrenar y desplegar modelos ML masivos utilizando cálculos distribuidos en AWS.
Técnicas de ajuste y optimización de rendimiento para modelos ML en entornos de producción.
Desarrollar conocimientos prácticos para la aplicación de soluciones ML impulsadas por HPC en industrias como la genómica y vehículos autónomos.

Autor(s)

Mani Khanuja, Farooq Sabir, Shreyas Subramanian, y Trenton Potgieter aportan una gran experiencia en el aprendizaje automático y la informática en la nube. Juntos, tienen una amplia experiencia en la implementación de aplicaciones ML escalables en varios dominios. Sus ideas únicas proporcionan orientación práctica para los estudiantes que buscan sobresalir en ML con AWS.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro está diseñado para ingenieros de aprendizaje automático y científicos de datos con conocimiento previo de los principios de ML, con el objetivo de expandirse a la computación de alto rendimiento. También es adecuado para especialistas de dominio en genómica, vehículos autónomos o CFD que deseen integrar los principios de ML utilizando AWS. Con sus ejemplos prácticos, es un activo para los profesionales que buscan mejorar sus habilidades en soluciones cloud escalables.

title: SAP® ABAP™ Questions and Answers
description: Designed as an introduction to the basics of ABAP or as a quick certification review, this book guides the reader through the intricacies of this programming language used by SAP components and applications (e.g., R/3, NetWeaver, etc.). It is currently positioned, alongside the more recently introduced Java, as the language for programming SAP's Web Application Server, part of its NetWeaver platform for building business applications. The question and answer format provides the reader with all of the details to pass certification exams in a step-by-step, easy to read, method of instruction.
translatedDescription: Diseñado como introducción a los fundamentos de ABAP o como revisión de certificación rápida, este libro guía al lector a través de las complejidades de este lenguaje de programación utilizado por componentes y aplicaciones de SAP (por ejemplo, R/3, NetWeaver, etc.). Actualmente está posicionado, junto con el Java más introducido recientemente, como el lenguaje para la programación del servidor de aplicaciones web de SAP, parte de su plataforma NetWeaver para la construcción de aplicaciones empresariales. El formato de pregunta y respuesta proporciona al lector todos los detalles para aprobar exámenes de certificación en un paso a paso, fácil de leer, método de instrucción.

title: Advanced Excel Success: A Practical Guide to Mastering Excel
description:
Explore advanced skills in Excel and gain an amazing array of tricks and tools to increase your productivity. This book discusses new techniques such as power functions, chart tricks, and many more to master Excel.

Advanced Excel Success starts with a few useful data tools in Excel followed by advanced formulas that will help you increase productivity. Here, you will learn power functions that aggregate, return ranges, and much more. Further, you will look at custom formatting tricks along with advanced charting tricks. These include automatically changing the color of key metrics, dynamically sorting chart data, and building creative labels.

Next, you will understand the role of Power Query which is one of the most important upgrades in Excel. Power Query is the Microsoft Data Connectivity and Data Preparation technology that enables business users to seamlessly access data stored in hundreds of data sources and reshape it to fit their needs, with an easy–to-use, engaging, and no-code user experience. Finally, you will learn Power Pivot which is a distinct feature in Excel that goes beyond spreadsheets. 

After reading this book, you will be well equipped to work on Excel with its advanced features. 

What You Will Learn

Work with the most useful data tools 
Understand formulas and the ten power functions
Use advanced chart and formatting tricks and techniques for dynamic and effective visuals
Work with power tools

Who This Book Is For 

Excel users looking to take the next step to expert level.
translatedDescription:
Explore habilidades avanzadas en Excel y obtenga una increíble variedad de trucos y herramientas para aumentar su productividad. Este libro discute nuevas técnicas como funciones de poder, trucos de gráfico y muchos más para dominar Excel.

El éxito avanzado de Excel comienza con algunas herramientas de datos útiles en Excel seguido de fórmulas avanzadas que le ayudarán a aumentar la productividad. Aquí, usted aprenderá las funciones de potencia que agregan, devuelven rangos, y mucho más. Además, verás trucos de formato personalizados junto con trucos de trazado avanzados. Estos incluyen cambiar automáticamente el color de las métricas clave, clasificar dinámicamente los datos del gráfico y construir etiquetas creativas.

A continuación, usted comprenderá el papel de Power Query que es una de las actualizaciones más importantes en Excel. Power Query es la tecnología Microsoft Data Connectivity y Data Preparation que permite a los usuarios de negocios acceder sin problemas a los datos almacenados en cientos de fuentes de datos y volver a configurarlos para satisfacer sus necesidades, con una experiencia de usuario fácil de usar, atractiva y sin código. Finalmente, usted aprenderá Power Pivot que es una característica distinta en Excel que va más allá de las hojas de cálculo.

Después de leer este libro, estará bien equipado para trabajar en Excel con sus características avanzadas.

Qué aprenderás

Trabajar con las herramientas de datos más útiles
Comprender fórmulas y las diez funciones de poder
Usar gráficos avanzados y formatear trucos y técnicas para visuales dinámicas y eficaces
Trabajar con herramientas eléctricas

Quién es este libro

Los usuarios de Excel que buscan dar el siguiente paso al nivel de expertos.

title: Constrained Principal Component Analysis and Related Techniques
description: This book shows how constrained principal component analysis (CPCA) offers a unified framework for regression techniques and PCA. Keeping the use of complicated iterative methods to a minimum, the book includes implementation details and many real application examples. It also offers material for methodologically oriented readers interested in developing statistical techniques of their own. MATLAB programs as well as data to create the book's examples are available on the author's website.
translatedDescription: Este libro muestra cómo el análisis de componentes principales restringidos (CPCA) ofrece un marco unificado para técnicas de regresión y PCA. Manteniendo al mínimo el uso de métodos iterativos complicados, el libro incluye detalles de implementación y muchos ejemplos de aplicación reales. También ofrece material para lectores de orientación metodológica interesados en desarrollar técnicas estadísticas propias. Los programas MATLAB así como los datos para crear los ejemplos del libro están disponibles en el sitio web del autor.

title: Information Literacy Landscapes
description:
Drawing upon the author’s on going research into information literacy, Information Literacy Landscapes explores the nature of the phenomenon from a socio-cultural perspective, which offers a more holistic approach to understanding information literacy as a catalyst for learning. This perspective emphasizes the dynamic relationship between learner and environment in the construction of knowledge. The approach underlines the importance of contextuality, through which social, cultural and embodied factors influence formal and informal learning. This book contributes to the understanding of information literacy and its role in formal and informal contexts.
Explores the shape of information literacy within education and workplace contexts
Introduces a holistic definition of information literacy which has been drawn from empirical studies in the workplace
Introduces a range of sensitizing concepts for researchers and practitioners
translatedDescription:
Basándose en la investigación del autor sobre la alfabetización de la información, Information Literacy Landscapes explora la naturaleza del fenómeno desde una perspectiva sociocultural, que ofrece un enfoque más holístico para comprender la alfabetización de la información como catalizador para el aprendizaje. Esta perspectiva enfatiza la relación dinámica entre el alumno y el medio ambiente en la construcción del conocimiento. El enfoque subraya la importancia de la contextualidad, mediante la cual los factores sociales, culturales y encarnados influyen en el aprendizaje formal e informal. Este libro contribuye a la comprensión de la alfabetización de la información y su papel en contextos formales e informales.
Explora la forma de la alfabetización de la información en los contextos de la educación y el trabajo
Introduce una definición holística de la alfabetización de la información que se ha extraído de estudios empíricos en el lugar de trabajo
Presenta una gama de conceptos de sensibilización para investigadores y profesionales

title: Tika in Action
description:
Tika in Action is a hands-on guide to content mining with Apache Tika. The book's many examples and case studies offer real-world experience from domains ranging from search engines to digital asset management and scientific data processing.

About the Technology

Tika is an Apache toolkit that has built into it everything you and your app need to know about file formats. Using Tika, your applications can discover and extract content from digital documents in almost any format, including exotic ones.

About the Book

Tika in Action is the ultimate guide to content mining using Apache Tika. You'll learn how to pull usable information from otherwise inaccessible sources, including internet media and file archives. This example-rich book teaches you to build and extend applications based on real-world experience with search engines, digital asset management, and scientific data processing. In addition to architectural overviews, you'll find detailed chapters on features like metadata extraction, automatic language detection, and custom parser development.

What's Inside
Crack MS Word, PDF, HTML, and ZIP
Integrate with search engines, CMS, and other data sources
Learn through experimentation
Many examples
About the Reader

This book requires no previous knowledge of Tika or text mining techniques. It assumes a working knowledge of Java.

About the Authors

Chris Mattmann is an information architect experienced in the construction of large data-intensive systems. Jukka Zitting is a core Tika developer, a member of the JCR expert group, and chairman of the Apache Jackrabbit project.

QuotesBy Tika's two main creators and maintainers.- Jérôme Charron, WebPulseEasily the most definitive guide to this great new text analysis toolkit.- John Guthrie, SAPAn easy-to-read guide--plenty of technical content.- Rick Wagner, Red HatThere's not a single page of 'inaction' in the entire book!- Sean Kelly, Technologist, NASAComplete, practical, accurate- Julien Nioche, DigitalPebble Ltd
translatedDescription:
Tika in Action es una guía práctica para la minería de contenidos con Apache Tika. Los numerosos ejemplos y estudios de casos del libro ofrecen experiencia real desde dominios que van desde motores de búsqueda hasta gestión de activos digitales y procesamiento de datos científicos.

Acerca de la tecnología

Tika es un kit de herramientas Apache que ha incorporado todo lo que usted y su aplicación necesitan saber acerca de formatos de archivo. Utilizando Tika, tus aplicaciones pueden descubrir y extraer contenido de documentos digitales en casi cualquier formato, incluyendo los exóticos.

Acerca del libro

Tika in Action es la guía final de la minería de contenidos usando Apache Tika. Aprenderás a sacar información usable de fuentes inaccesibles, incluyendo los medios de Internet y archivos de archivos. Este libro rico en ejemplos le enseña a construir y ampliar aplicaciones basadas en la experiencia real con motores de búsqueda, gestión de activos digitales y procesamiento de datos científicos. Además de los panoramas arquitectónicos, encontrará capítulos detallados sobre características como extracción de metadatos, detección automática de idiomas y desarrollo de parser personalizado.

Qué hay dentro
Crack MS Word, PDF, HTML y ZIP
Integrar con motores de búsqueda, CMS y otras fuentes de datos
Aprende a través de la experimentación
Muchos ejemplos
Sobre el lector

Este libro no requiere ningún conocimiento previo de Tika o técnicas de extracción de texto. Asume un conocimiento de trabajo de Java.

Acerca de los autores

Chris Mattmann es un arquitecto de información experimentado en la construcción de grandes sistemas intensivos de datos. Jukka Zitting es un desarrollador básico de Tika, miembro del grupo experto de JCR, y presidente del proyecto Apache Jackrabbit.

CitasPor los dos principales creadores y colaboradores de Tika.- Jérôme Charron, WebPulse Fácilmente la guía más definitiva de este nuevo kit de herramientas de análisis de texto.- John Guthrie, SAPUna guía fácil de leer--plenty of technical content.- Rick Wagner, Red Hat¡No hay una sola página de 'inacción' en todo el libro!- Sean Kelly, Technologist, NASAComplete, practical, accurate- Julien Nioche, DigitalPebble Ltd

title: Stochastic Financial Models
description: Developed from the esteemed author's advanced undergraduate and graduate courses at the University of Cambridge, this text provides a hands-on, sound introduction to mathematical finance. Assuming no prior knowledge of stochastic calculus or measure-theoretic probability, the author includes the relevant mathematical background as well as many exercises with solutions. He first presents the classical topics of utility and the mean-variance approach to portfolio choice. Focusing on derivative pricing, the text then covers the binomial model, the general discrete-time model, Brownian motion, the Black-Scholes model, and various interest-rate models.
translatedDescription: Desarrollado a partir de los prestigiosos cursos avanzados de pregrado y licenciatura del autor en la Universidad de Cambridge, este texto proporciona una introducción práctica y sólida a la financiación matemática. Asumiendo que no se conozca previamente el cálculo estocástico o la probabilidad teórica de medida, el autor incluye el fondo matemático relevante, así como muchos ejercicios con soluciones. En primer lugar presenta los temas clásicos de utilidad y el enfoque de variabilidad media a la elección de cartera. Centrándose en los precios derivados, el texto cubre el modelo binomio, el modelo general discreto, el movimiento Brownian, el modelo Black-Scholes y varios modelos de tipos de interés.

title: Jumpstart Snowflake: A Step-by-Step Guide to Modern Cloud Analytics
description:
Explore the modern market of data analytics platforms and the benefits of using Snowflake computing, the data warehouse built for the cloud.

With the rise of cloud technologies, organizations prefer to deploy their analytics using cloud providers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Cloud vendors are offering modern data platforms for building cloud analytics solutions to collect data and consolidate into single storage solutions that provide insights for business users. The core of any analytics framework is the data warehouse, and previously customers did not have many choices of platform to use.

Snowflake was built specifically for the cloud and it is a true game changer for the analytics market. This book will help onboard you to Snowflake, present best practices to deploy, and use the Snowflake data warehouse. In addition, it covers modern analytics architecture and use cases. It provides use cases of integration with leading analytics software such as Matillion ETL, Tableau, and Databricks.  Finally, it covers migration scenarios for on-premise legacy data warehouses.

What You Will Learn

Know the key functionalities of Snowflake
Set up security and access with cluster
Bulk load data into Snowflake using the COPY command
Migrate from a legacy data warehouse to Snowflake
integrate the Snowflake data platform with modern business intelligence (BI) and data integration tools

Who This Book Is For

Those working with data warehouse and business intelligence (BI) technologies, and existing and potential Snowflake users
translatedDescription:
Explore el mercado moderno de las plataformas de análisis de datos y los beneficios de usar el cálculo Snowflake, el almacén de datos construido para la nube.

Con el aumento de las tecnologías de la nube, las organizaciones prefieren desplegar sus análisis utilizando proveedores de cloud como Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure o Google Cloud Platform. Los proveedores de Cloud ofrecen plataformas de datos modernas para crear soluciones de análisis de cloud para recopilar datos y consolidarse en soluciones de almacenamiento únicas que proporcionan información a los usuarios de negocios. El núcleo de cualquier marco analítico es el almacén de datos, y anteriormente los clientes no tenían muchas opciones de plataforma que utilizar.

Snowflake fue construido específicamente para la nube y es un verdadero cambio de juego para el mercado de análisis. Este libro le ayudará a bordo de Snowflake, presentar las mejores prácticas para desplegar, y utilizar el almacén de datos Snowflake. Además, cubre la arquitectura analítica moderna y los casos de uso. Proporciona casos de integración con software de análisis líder como Matillion ETL, Tableau y Databricks. Por último, abarca los escenarios de migración para los almacenes de datos heredados en premisa.

Qué aprenderás

Conocer las funcionalidades clave de Snowflake
Configurar seguridad y acceso con cluster
Datos de carga a granel en Snowflake usando el comando COPY
Migrar desde un almacén de datos legado a Snowflake
integrar la plataforma de datos Snowflake con la inteligencia empresarial moderna (BI) y herramientas de integración de datos

Quién es este libro

Los que trabajan con tecnologías de almacenamiento de datos e inteligencia empresarial (BI) y los usuarios existentes y potenciales de Snowflake

title: Practical Data Science with SAP
description:
Learn how to fuse today's data science tools and techniques with your SAP enterprise resource planning (ERP) system. With this practical guide, SAP veterans Greg Foss and Paul Modderman demonstrate how to use several data analysis tools to solve interesting problems with your SAP data.

Data engineers and scientists will explore ways to add SAP data to their analysis processes, while SAP business analysts will learn practical methods for answering questions about the business. By focusing on grounded explanations of both SAP processes and data science tools, this book gives data scientists and business analysts powerful methods for discovering deep data truths.

You'll explore:

Examples of how data analysis can help you solve several SAP challenges
Natural language processing for unlocking the secrets in text
Data science techniques for data clustering and segmentation
Methods for detecting anomalies in your SAP data
Data visualization techniques for making your data come to life
translatedDescription:

Los ingenieros y científicos de datos explorarán maneras de agregar datos de SAP a sus procesos de análisis, mientras que los analistas de negocios de SAP aprenderán métodos prácticos para responder preguntas sobre el negocio. Centrándose en explicaciones fundamentadas tanto de los procesos de SAP como de las herramientas de ciencia de datos, este libro ofrece a los científicos de datos y analistas de negocios métodos poderosos para descubrir verdades de datos profundas.

Explorarás:

Ejemplos de cómo el análisis de datos puede ayudarle a resolver varios retos de SAP
Procesamiento de lenguaje natural para desbloquear los secretos en texto
Técnicas de ciencia de datos para agrupación de datos y segmentación
Métodos para detectar anomalías en sus datos de SAP
Técnicas de visualización de datos para hacer que sus datos lleguen a la vida

title: Mobile Artificial Intelligence Projects
description:
Mobile Artificial Intelligence Projects is your essential guide to creating innovative AI-powered applications on Android and iOS platforms. By following this book, you will explore various technologies for mobile artificial intelligence and build hands-on projects such as image recognition, NLP tasks, and predictive analytics. Unlock the power of AI to develop customized, intuitive mobile apps in no time.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the fundamentals of AI, neural networks, and how they integrate into mobile platforms.
Learn to implement AI techniques to perform NLP, computer vision, and predictive analytics tasks.
Discover the process of creating TensorFlow models and deploying them on Android and iOS.
Gain experience using popular libraries such as TensorFlow Lite, PyTorch, and CoreML.
Develop practical mobile AI applications, from handwritten digit recognition to real-estate predictions.

Author(s)

None NG is an AI expert with years of experience in mobile app development. None Padmanabhan specializes in implementing machine learning models on edge devices, and Matt Cole is a software engineer passionate about teaching AI concepts to a broad audience. Who is it for?

This book is for software engineers and developers with a foundational understanding of programming and machine learning who wish to apply and deploy artificial intelligence on mobile platforms. It is ideal for learners looking to enhance their technical skills with hands-on projects and aspiring to join the forefront of AI innovation.

title: Convergence: Artificial Intelligence and Quantum Computing
description:
Prepare for the coming convergence of AI and quantum computing

A collection of essays from 20 renowned, international authors working in industry, academia, and government, Convergence: Artificial Intelligence and Quantum Computing explains the impending convergence of artificial intelligence and quantum computing. A diversity of viewpoints is presented, each offering their view of this coming watershed event.

In the book, you’ll discover that we’re on the cusp of seeing the stuff of science fiction become reality, with huge implications for ripping up the existing social fabric, global economy, and current geopolitical order. Along with an incisive foreword by Hugo- and Nebula-award winning author David Brin, you’ll also find:

Explorations of the increasing pace of technological development
Explanations of why seemingly unusual and surprising breakthroughs might be just around the corner
Maps to navigate the potential minefields that await us as AI and quantum computing come together

A fascinating and thought-provoking compilation of insights from some of the leading technological voices in the world, Convergence convincingly argues that we should prepare for a world in which very little will remain the same and shows us how to get ready.

Se presenta una diversidad de puntos de vista, cada uno que ofrece su visión de este próximo evento de cuenca.

En el libro, descubrirás que estamos a punto de ver que las cosas de la ciencia ficción se hacen realidad, con enormes implicaciones para recortar el tejido social existente, la economía global y el orden geopolítico actual. Junto con un prefacio incisivo de Hugo- y Nebula-award autor ganador David Brin, también encontrará:

Exploraciones del ritmo cada vez mayor del desarrollo tecnológico
Explicaciones de por qué los avances aparentemente inusuales y sorprendentes podrían estar a la vuelta de la esquina
Mapas para navegar por los campos de minas potenciales que nos esperan mientras IA y Cálculo cuántico se reúnen

title: The Art of Data-Driven Business
description:
Learn how to integrate data-driven methodologies and machine learning into your business decision-making processes with 'The Art of Data-Driven Business.' This comprehensive guide shows you how to apply Python-based machine learning techniques to real-world challenges, transforming your organization into an innovative and well-informed enterprise.

What this Book will help me do

Create professional-quality data visualizations using Python's seaborn library to derive business insights.
Analyze customer behavior, including predicting churn, with machine learning techniques.
Apply clustering algorithms to segment customers for targeted marketing campaigns.
Utilize pandas effectively for pricing and sales analytics to optimize your pricing strategies.
Forecast outcomes of promotional strategies to determine costs and benefits and maximize performance.

Author(s)

None Palacio is an experienced data scientist and educator who specializes in the application of machine learning to solve business problems. With extensive real-world industry experience, Palacio brings practical insights and methodologies to learners. Their teaching connects technical knowledge to actionable business strategies.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for business professionals aiming to incorporate data science into their strategies and technical experts seeking to leverage machine learning for business scenarios. Beginners to Python can find foundational help, while data scientists will appreciate the focused practical applications. It's perfect for individuals seeking a strong data-driven perspective in marketing, sales, and customer management.

Cree visualizaciones de datos de calidad profesional utilizando la biblioteca marina de Python para obtener información de negocios.

title: Credible Checklists and Quality Questionnaires
description:
Credible Checklists and Quality Questionnaires starts off with an examination of the critical but commonly overlooked checklist method.

In the second chapter, questionnaires and surveys are discussed. Asking questions sounds simple, but the hard truth is that asking questions (and designing questionnaires) is a difficult task. This chapter discusses being mindful of the choice of words, order of questions and how early questions influence later questions, answer scales and how they impact the user response, questionnaire design, and much more.

The final chapter provides examples of some common questionnaires (both free and fee-based) for assessing the usability of products.

After reading this book, readers will be able to use these user design tools with greater confidence and certainty.
translatedDescription:
Listas de verificación creíbles y cuestionarios de calidad comienzan con un examen del método crítico pero comúnmente pasado por alto.

En el segundo capítulo se examinan cuestionarios y encuestas. Hacer preguntas suena simple, pero la verdad difícil es que hacer preguntas (y diseñar cuestionarios) es una tarea difícil. En este capítulo se habla de la elección de palabras, orden de preguntas y de cómo las preguntas tempranas influyen en preguntas posteriores, escalas de respuestas y cómo afectan la respuesta del usuario, diseño de cuestionarios y mucho más.

El capítulo final ofrece ejemplos de algunos cuestionarios comunes (tanto libres como basados en tarifas) para evaluar la usabilidad de los productos.

Después de leer este libro, los lectores podrán utilizar estas herramientas de diseño de usuarios con mayor confianza y certeza.

title: What Is Ray?
description:
The use of distributed programming is increasing. High availability requires multiple machines and often multiple data centers. Machine learning and AI models are run as parallel tasks on clusters to reduce training time. But distributed programming has always been hard to do--at least, until now. This report shows you an easier way.

Dean Wampler from Anyscale introduces you to Ray, an open source project that provides a concise and intuitive Python API for defining tasks that need to be distributed. Built by researchers at UC Berkeley, Ray does most of the tedious work of running workloads at massive scale. For the majority of distributed workloads, this guide shows you how Ray provides a flexible, efficient, and intuitive way to get work done.

Learn how Ray builds on familiar language concepts: functions for stateless tasks and classes for stateful computing
Use Ray libraries for reinforcement learning, hyperparameter tuning, distributed training of TensorFlow and PyTorch models, and model serving
Work with Ray for general application development, including conventional microservices and serverless applications
Get hands-on instruction using live Ray code with Dean Wampler's Meet the Expert session on O'Reilly online learning
translatedDescription:
El uso de la programación distribuida está aumentando. La alta disponibilidad requiere múltiples máquinas y a menudo múltiples centros de datos. Los modelos de aprendizaje automático y IA se ejecutan como tareas paralelas en grupos para reducir el tiempo de entrenamiento. Pero la programación distribuida siempre ha sido difícil de hacer, al menos hasta ahora. Este informe te muestra una manera más fácil.

Dean Wampler de Anyscale le presenta a Ray, un proyecto de código abierto que proporciona una API Python concisa e intuitiva para definir tareas que necesitan ser distribuidas. Construido por investigadores de la UC Berkeley, Ray hace la mayor parte del trabajo tedioso de ejecutar cargas de trabajo a gran escala. Para la mayoría de las cargas de trabajo distribuidas, esta guía le muestra cómo Ray proporciona una manera flexible, eficiente e intuitiva para hacer el trabajo.

Aprende cómo Ray se basa en conceptos de lenguaje familiar: funciones para tareas apátridas y clases para computación apática
Utilice bibliotecas Ray para el aprendizaje de refuerzo, afinación hiperparamétrica, entrenamiento distribuido de modelos TensorFlow y PyTorch, y servicio modelo
Trabaja con Ray para el desarrollo de aplicaciones generales, incluyendo microservicios convencionales y aplicaciones sin servidor
Obtenga instrucciones prácticas usando código de Ray en vivo con Dean Wampler's Meet the Expert session on O'Reilly online learning

title: Biological Computation
description:
The area of biologically inspired computing, or biological computation, involves the development of new, biologically based techniques for solving difficult computational problems. A unified overview of computer science ideas inspired by biology, Biological Computation presents the most fundamental and significant concepts in this area. In the book, students discover that bacteria communicate, that DNA can be used for performing computations, how evolution solves optimization problems, that the way ants organize their nests can be applied to solve clustering problems, and what the human immune system can teach us about protecting computer networks. The authors discuss more biological examples such as these, along with the computational techniques developed from these scenarios.

The text focuses on cellular automata, evolutionary computation, neural networks, and molecular computation. Each chapter explores the biological background, describes the computational techniques, gives examples of applications, discusses possible variants of the techniques, and includes exercises and solutions. The authors use the examples and exercises to illustrate key ideas and techniques.

Clearly conveying the essence of the major computational approaches in the field, this book brings students to the point where they can either produce a working implementation of the techniques or effectively use one of the many available implementations. Moreover, the techniques discussed reflect fundamental principles that can be applied beyond bio-inspired computing. Supplementary material is available on Dr. Unger's website.
translatedDescription:
El área de computación biológicamente inspirada, o computación biológica, implica el desarrollo de nuevas técnicas biológicas para resolver problemas computacionales difíciles. Un panorama unificado de las ideas informáticas inspiradas en la biología, la Computación Biológica presenta los conceptos más fundamentales y significativos en esta área. En el libro, los estudiantes descubren que las bacterias se comunican, que el ADN se puede utilizar para realizar computaciones, cómo la evolución resuelve problemas de optimización, que la forma en que las hormigas organizan sus nidos se puede aplicar para resolver problemas de agrupación, y lo que el sistema inmunológico humano puede enseñarnos sobre la protección de las redes informáticas. Los autores discuten más ejemplos biológicos como estos, junto con las técnicas computacionales desarrolladas a partir de estos escenarios.

El texto se centra en automata celular, computación evolutiva, redes neuronales y computación molecular. Cada capítulo explora el fondo biológico, describe las técnicas computacionales, da ejemplos de aplicaciones, analiza posibles variantes de las técnicas, e incluye ejercicios y soluciones. Los autores utilizan los ejemplos y ejercicios para ilustrar ideas y técnicas clave.

Transmitiendo claramente la esencia de los principales enfoques computacionales en el campo, este libro lleva a los estudiantes al punto en que pueden producir una implementación de las técnicas o utilizar eficazmente una de las muchas implementaciones disponibles. Además, las técnicas discutidas reflejan principios fundamentales que pueden aplicarse más allá de la computación bio-inspirada. El material complementario está disponible en el sitio web del Dr. Unger.

title: Oracle Essbase & Oracle OLAP
description:

Set up high-availability PostgreSQL clusters using modern best practices.
Monitor and tune database performance to handle enterprise-level workloads seamlessly.
Automate testing and implement test-driven development strategies for robust applications.
Leverage PostgreSQL along with DevOps pipelines to deploy applications on cloud platforms.
Develop APIs and geospatial databases using popular tools like PostgREST and PostGIS.

A basic knowledge of PostgreSQL and Linux will help you dive into the hands-on projects easily. If you're looking to take your PostgreSQL skills to the next level, this book is for you.

title: Understanding Uncertainty, Revised Edition
description:
Praise for the First Edition

"...a reference for everyone who is interested in knowing and handling uncertainty."

—Journal of Applied Statistics

The critically acclaimed First Edition of Understanding Uncertainty provided a study of uncertainty addressed to scholars in all fields, showing that uncertainty could be measured by probability, and that probability obeyed three basic rules that enabled uncertainty to be handled sensibly in everyday life. These ideas were extended to embrace the scientific method and to show how decisions, containing an uncertain element, could be rationally made.

Featuring new material, the Revised Edition remains the go-to guide for uncertainty and decision making, providing further applications at an accessible level including:

A critical study of transitivity, a basic concept in probability

A discussion of how the failure of the financial sector to use the proper approach to uncertainty may have contributed to the recent recession

A consideration of betting, showing that a bookmaker's odds are not expressions of probability

Applications of the book's thesis to statistics

A demonstration that some techniques currently popular in statistics, like significance tests, may be unsound, even seriously misleading, because they violate the rules of probability

Understanding Uncertainty, Revised Edition is ideal for students studying probability or statistics and for anyone interested in one of the most fascinating and vibrant fields of study in contemporary science and mathematics.
translatedDescription:
Alabado por la Primera Edición

"...una referencia para todos los interesados en conocer y manejar la incertidumbre."

—Journal of Applied Statistics

La críticamente aclamada Primera Edición de Entendimiento La incertidumbre proporcionó un estudio de incertidumbre dirigido a los eruditos en todos los campos, demostrando que la incertidumbre podría medirse por probabilidad, y que la probabilidad obedecía tres reglas básicas que permitían que la incertidumbre se manejara sensiblemente en la vida cotidiana. Estas ideas se ampliaron para abarcar el método científico y para mostrar cómo podrían tomarse racionalmente las decisiones, conteniendo un elemento incierto.

Con material nuevo, la edición revisada sigue siendo la guía para la incertidumbre y la toma de decisiones, proporcionando nuevas aplicaciones a un nivel accesible, incluyendo:

Un estudio crítico de la transitividad, un concepto básico de probabilidad

Un debate sobre cómo el fracaso del sector financiero para utilizar el enfoque adecuado de la incertidumbre puede haber contribuido a la reciente recesión

Una consideración de apuestas, mostrando que las probabilidades de un corredor de apuestas no son expresiones de probabilidad

Aplicaciones de la tesis del libro a las estadísticas

Una demostración de que algunas técnicas actualmente populares en las estadísticas, como pruebas de significado, pueden ser insonorizadas, incluso gravemente engañosas, porque violan las reglas de probabilidad

Comprender la incertidumbre, edición revisada es ideal para estudiantes que estudian probabilidad o estadísticas y para cualquier persona interesada en uno de los campos de estudio más fascinantes y vibrantes de la ciencia contemporánea y las matemáticas.

title: Mastering spaCy

Understand the capabilities of the spaCy NLP library and its applications.
Build and customize NLP models proficiently using spaCy.
Apply spaCy tools for text processing, such as rule-based and machine learning approaches.
Perform sentiment analysis, keyword extraction, and text classification effectively.
Design and implement a functional chatbot using spaCy's features.

Author(s)

Duygu Altınok is a seasoned expert in natural language processing and computational linguistics, with extensive experience in developing machine learning applications. Altınok has a dedication to providing clear, hands-on guidance to developers looking to harness the power of spaCy for NLP tasks. Their approach to instruction emphasizes practical implementation and thorough understanding of the subject matter.

This book is ideal for data scientists and NLP developers aiming to enhance their skills in spaCy and build efficient language models. It's also valuable for software developers seeking to quickly prototype NLP solutions and for linguistics professionals delving into computational applications. A basic knowledge of Python and some linguistic concepts like semantic similarity will maximize the reader's benefit from this resource.

title: SciPy Recipes
description:
Dive into the world of scientific computing with 'SciPy Recipes', a practical guide tailored for anyone seeking hands-on experience with the SciPy stack. With over 110 detailed recipes, you'll gain expertise in handling real-world data challenges, from statistical computations to crafting intricate visualizations and beyond.

title: Bio-Inspired Strategies for Modeling and Detection in Diabetes Mellitus Treatment
description:
Bio-Inspired Strategies for Modeling and Detection in Diabetes Mellitus Treatment focuses on bio-inspired techniques such as modelling to generate control algorithms for the treatment of diabetes mellitus. The book addresses the identification of diabetes mellitus using a high-order recurrent neural network trained by the extended Kalman filter. The authors also describe the use of metaheuristic algorithms for the parametric identification of compartmental models of diabetes mellitus widely used in research works such as the Sorensen model and the Dallaman model. In addition, the book addresses the modelling of time series for the prediction of risk scenarios such as hyperglycaemia and hypoglycaemia using deep neural networks. The detection of diabetes mellitus in early stages or when current diagnostic techniques cannot detect glucose intolerance or prediabetes is proposed, carried out by means of deep neural networks in force in the literature. Readers will find leading-edge research in diabetes identification based on discrete high-order neural networks trained with the extended Kalman filter; parametric identification of compartmental models used to describe diabetes mellitus; modelling of data obtained by continuous glucose monitoring sensors for the prediction of risk scenarios such as hyperglycaemia and hypoglycaemia; and screening for glucose intolerance using glucose tolerance test data and deep neural networks. Application of the proposed approaches is illustrated via simulation and real-time implementations for modelling, prediction, and classification.
Addresses the online identification of diabetes mellitus using a high-order recurrent neural network trained online by an extended Kalman filter.
Covers parametric identification of compartmental models used to describe diabetes mellitus.
Provides modeling of data obtained by continuous glucose-monitoring sensors for the prediction of risk scenarios such as hyperglycaemia and hypoglycaemia.

El libro aborda la identificación de la diabetes mellitus utilizando una red neuronal recidivante de alto orden entrenada por el filtro Kalman extendido. Los autores también describen el uso de algoritmos metaheuristas para la identificación paramétrica de modelos compartimentales de diabetes mellitus ampliamente utilizados en trabajos de investigación como el modelo Sorensen y el modelo Dallaman. Además, el libro aborda el modelado de series temporales para la predicción de escenarios de riesgo como hiperglucemia e hipoglicemia utilizando redes neuronales profundas. Se propone la detección de diabetes mellitus en etapas tempranas o cuando las técnicas de diagnóstico actuales no pueden detectar intolerancia a la glucosa o prediabetes, llevadas a cabo por medio de redes neuronales profundas en vigor en la literatura. Los lectores encontrarán investigación de vanguardia en la identificación de la diabetes basada en redes neuronales discretas de alto orden entrenadas con el filtro Kalman ampliado; identificación paramétrica de modelos compartimentales utilizados para describir la diabetes mellitus; modelado de datos obtenidos mediante sensores de monitoreo continuo de glucosa para la predicción de escenarios de riesgo como hiperglucemia e hipoglucemia; y detección de intolerancia a la glucosa utilizando datos de prueba de tolerancia y redes neuronales profundas.
